_comment: Hand-maintained details, keyed by the sheet title lowercased. Merged over the Steam data, so any field here wins. title = clean display name (the sheet keeps Evan's spelling). Console exclusives get description, genres, year and developer here; cover and scores are filled from Wikipedia.

breath of the wild.description: Open-air adventure across a ruined Hyrule: climb anything, cook everything, and take on Ganon whenever you feel ready.
breath of the wild.title: Zelda: Breath of the Wild

tears of the kingdom.description: Link returns to Hyrule and the sky islands above it, building machines from whatever he finds to explore land, sky and the depths below.
tears of the kingdom.title: Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

super mario odyssey.description: Mario and his sentient hat Cappy sail between sandbox kingdoms, possessing enemies and hunting Power Moons to stop Bowser's wedding.

super mario 3d world.description: Colorful co-op platforming with the cat suit, on the Switch version with the Bowser's Fury open-world adventure included.

super mario rpg remastered.description: A full remake of the 1996 RPG: Mario, Bowser and Peach team up in timed turn-based battles against the Smithy Gang.
super mario rpg remastered.title: Super Mario RPG

link awakening.description: Link washes up on Koholint Island in a toy-box remake of the Game Boy classic, gathering instruments to wake the Wind Fish.
link awakening.title: Zelda: Link's Awakening

echoes of wisdom.description: Zelda takes the lead, copying objects and monsters as echoes to solve puzzles her own way and rescue a kingdom swallowed by rifts.
echoes of wisdom.title: Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom

super smash bros ultimate.description: The crossover fighter with every character the series has ever had, all on one roster.
super smash bros ultimate.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate

mario + rabbids.description: Tactical turn-based battles with Mario, his friends and their Rabbid lookalikes, in a world knocked sideways by a strange device.
mario + rabbids.title: Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle

pikmin 4.description: Command a growing squad of tiny plant creatures and a rescue dog named Oatchi to explore a strange planet and recover what's lost there.

metroid dread.description: Samus hunts through a hostile planet while unstoppable E.M.M.I. robots hunt her, in the first new 2D Metroid in nineteen years.

metroid prime remastered.description: The first-person Metroid classic rebuilt with new visuals: Samus scans and blasts her way through the ruins of Tallon IV.

astral chain.description: A futuristic police officer fights interdimensional creatures while chained to a living weapon called a Legion.

advance wars.description: A remake of the first two Advance Wars games: bright, sharp turn-based tactics with tanks, planes and commanding officers.

dk tropical freeze.description: Donkey Kong and family fight to take back their frozen island in tough, beautifully animated side-scrolling platforming.
dk tropical freeze.title: Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze

dk bananza.description: Donkey Kong punches his way through destructible worlds toward the planet's core, with a teenage Pauline along for the ride.
dk bananza.title: Donkey Kong Bananza

astro bot.description: A tiny robot chases his scattered crew through inventive worlds in a joyful platformer built around the DualSense controller.

bloodborne.description: A hunter stalks the gothic streets of Yharnam through a nightmare of beasts and cosmic horror, in FromSoftware's most aggressive combat.

ghost of yotei.description: A lone mercenary named Atsu hunts the gang that killed her family across the wilds around Mount Yotei in 1600s Japan.
ghost of yotei.title: Ghost of Yōtei

infamous second son.description: Delsin Rowe discovers he can absorb superpowers like smoke and neon, and turns them on an occupied Seattle.
infamous second son.title: inFAMOUS Second Son

shadow of the colossus.description: A lone traveler rides across a forbidden land, climbing and felling sixteen giant colossi to bring back someone he lost.

tony hawks pro skater 1 & 2.description: The first two Pro Skater games rebuilt from the ground up, with the original levels, soundtrack and skaters plus new ones.
tony hawks pro skater 1 & 2.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2

humanity.description: Guide endless crowds of people through puzzle stages as a glowing Shiba Inu, in a strange and striking puzzle-action game.

gta 6.description: Rockstar's return to Vice City and the state of Leonida, following criminal partners Lucia and Jason.
gta 6.title: Grand Theft Auto VI

gow laufey.description: An upcoming God of War from Santa Monica Studio, on PlayStation 5.
gow laufey.title: God of War Laufey

ocarina of time remake.description: Evan's list has this as a remake of Link's Nintendo 64 adventure. We couldn't find a listing for it yet.
ocarina of time remake.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake

ori blind forest & will of the wisps.title: Ori and the Blind Forest & Will of the Wisps

metal gear solid phantom pain.title: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain
